fact: 1921年12月6日凌晨2:15，英爱双方全权代表在伦敦唐宁街10号签署《英爱条约》（Articles of Agreement for a Treaty between Great Britain and Ireland）。爱尔兰代表团由阿瑟·格里菲斯率领（成员包括迈克尔·柯林斯、罗伯特·巴顿、埃蒙·杜根、乔治·加万·达菲），英方由劳合·乔治率领。条约规定建立爱尔兰自由邦（26郡），为英帝国内的自治领；北爱尔兰6郡可选择退出；英国保留三个海军基地。12月5日晚劳合·乔治发出最后通牒：不签约将面临「immediate and terrible war」。

sources.title: Oireachtas, The Treaty in Context
sources.quote: The Anglo-Irish Treaty was the peace agreement that brought the Irish War of Independence to an end. ... The Treaty signed on 6 December 1921 was a landmark agreement in the history of the two islands. ... The British Prime Minister, David Lloyd George, was adamant that the British view of the Crown and Ireland's membership of the Commonwealth had to be part of the final agreement.

sources.title: RTÉ Century Ireland, The Treaty Debates Explained
sources.quote: On the evening of 5 December Lloyd George declared to the Irish Plenipotentiaries that the consequence of a no-deal would not be a continuation of the existing truce – in place since July 1921 – but the onset of an 'immediate and terrible war' and 'war within three days'. The Anglo-Irish Treaty only ran to a length of 1,800 words and did not deliver the republic desired.

fact: 1921年7月11日中午，爱尔兰共和军（IRA）与英国军队之间的停战协定（Truce）正式生效，结束了持续两年半的爱尔兰独立战争（1919年1月—1921年7月）。停战协定在都柏林市长官邸（Mansion House）于7月8日宣布。停战使IRA获得战斗力量的承认（而非犯罪团伙），IRA成员和Dáil议员免于逮捕，不以交出武器为前提。战争造成约2346人死亡（其中平民919人、共和军491人、警察523人、军人413人）。

sources.title: Kildare Library Service, The Truce, 11 July 1921
sources.quote: A truce between the Irish Republican Army (IRA) and the British crown forces came into effect at twelve o'clock (noon) on Monday, 11 July 1921. ... The War of Independence had caused 2,346 deaths, the majority after the arrival of the Black and Tans. ... the figures for the breakdown of casualties from The Dead of the Irish Revolution (O'Halpin, E. & Ó Corráin, D.) – published 2020 – from 1917-21 are 919 civilians, 491 Irish republicans, 523 police, and 413 military.

sources.title: Dublin City Council, History on your Doorstep Vol.2
sources.quote: The truce that ended the War of Independence was signed at the Corporation's new home, the Mansion House, on 9 July 1921 and came into effect on 11 July.

fact: 1921年5月25日，IRA对都柏林海关大楼（Custom House）发动袭击，企图瘫痪英国行政体系，但行动失败：5名IRA成员阵亡、近100人被俘。此次损失使IRA活动大幅减少，直到7月停战。同年3月14日，6名IRA成员在都柏林芒特乔伊监狱被处决。

sources.title: Dublin City Council, History on your Doorstep Vol.2
sources.quote: on 25 May 1921 the IRA staged a disastrous assault on the Customs House, which saw five IRA members killed and almost 100 captured. The losses were so considerable that IRA activity dropped off significantly until the truce on 11 July.

fact: 1921年12月14日至1922年1月10日，Dáil Éireann在都柏林厄尔斯福特台（Earlsfort Terrace，今国家音乐厅）就英爱条约展开辩论。辩论历时15天，发言超过44万词、约2300次发言。1922年1月7日，Dáil以64票对57票批准条约。德·瓦莱拉在辩论中发言334次、超过4万词。条约批准后，反条约派议员退场抗议，格里菲斯当选Dáil主席。

sources.title: RTÉ Century Ireland, The Treaty Debates Explained
sources.quote: The debates began on 14 December 1921 and effectively concluded with Arthur Griffith being elected to replace Éamon de Valera as President of Dáil Éireann on 10 January 1922. The critical vote on whether to ratify or reject the Treaty was taken on 7 January. ... Across those 15 days of debates at Earlsfort Terrace, over 440,000 words were spoken... there were almost 2,300 individual contributions.

sources.title: National Library of Ireland, Revealing History: Arthur Griffith
sources.quote: On 7 January 1922 Griffith provided a robust defense of the Treaty in the Dáil to counter the arguments of de Valera and other anti-Treaty TDs. The pro-Treaty side prevailed later that day when Dáil Eireann ratified the Treaty by sixty-four votes to fifty-seven.

fact: 1921年爱尔兰生活成本远高于英国。据爱尔兰工会大会（Irish Labour Party/TUC）调查：标准食品配给（面包、黄油、牛奶、茶、糖、牛肉、羊肉、土豆、鸡蛋、培根等）的均价从1914年3月的7先令8便士涨到1921年3月的22先令（上涨187%）、1921年5月的21先令4便士（上涨178%）。英国贸易委员会同期数据仅上涨149%和132%。衣物零售价比1914年7月高约210%。综合生活成本在爱尔兰约高于战前175%，而英国官方估计仅128%。

sources.title: Irish Labour History Society, 27th Annual Report 1921（Irish TUC调查报告）
sources.quote: In March, 1914, the average price for the ration in question was 7/8. In March, 1921, the average price for the same ration was 22 (or 187 per cent. above pre-war). In May, 1921, the average price for the same ration was 21/4 (or 178 per cent. above pre-war). ... the cost of living in Ireland is still about 175 per cent. above pre-war level.

sources.title: Dublin Evening Telegraph, High Prices in Dublin（1921-08-24，经Creative Centenaries转载）
sources.quote: It does not seem to be disputed that prices in Dublin are higher than prices of similar commodities in London and other English centres. This one fact alone has serious import for every manufacturer and worker in Dublin, it means that their industries cannot compete successfully with English industries.

fact: 1921年7月停战后，都柏林建筑业新工资标准：工匠每小时1先令10便士至2先令2便士，工人（labourer）至少为相应工匠工资的四分之三。与1913年锁厂前工资（工匠每日6先令、工人每日3先令4便士）相比大幅上涨。1921年11月农产品批发价参考：都柏林鸡蛋每120枚36先令3便士（上周57先令1便士），黄油每磅1先令2½便士，鸡每对11先令6便士。

sources.title: Perlego, A City in Civil War – Dublin 1921–1924（书摘）
sources.quote: new wage rates were struck for the building trade to usher in an era of industrial peace. Craftsmen can expect to earn between 1s 10d and 2s 2d an hour, while labourers were entitled to at least three-quarters of the relevant craft rate. These were vast increases on the old pre-lockout rates of 1913, when a craft worker might earn 6s a day and a labourer 3s 4d.

sources.title: Limerick Leader/Limerick Local Studies, 26 November 1921（农产品批发价周报）
sources.quote: At Dublin prices gave way from 57s 1d to 36s 3d [eggs per 120]. ... Farmers' Butter: Dublin prices gave way fractionally from 1s 3½d to 1s 2½d [per lb]. ... Chickens: At Belfast, Dublin, Enniscorthy and Limerick the previous rates of 9s 6d, 11s 6d, 8s, and 7s per pair respectively were repeated.

fact: 1920年《爱尔兰政府法》（Government of Ireland Act 1920）正式分割爱尔兰，建立北爱尔兰议会（1921年6月由詹姆斯·克雷格任首相首次召开）。英爱条约规定北爱尔兰可选择退出自由邦（北爱议会随即行使了退出权），并设立边界委员会。条约签订时北爱尔兰已合法存在数月，但条约文本未提及北爱尔兰。英国保留三个海军基地。爱尔兰自由邦获得国内事务完全自治权：征税、管理对外贸易、组建军队、外交政策相当自由。

sources.title: Oireachtas, The Treaty in Context
sources.quote: No reference was made to Northern Ireland, although it had legally been in existence for a number of months at this point. ... The six counties of Northern Ireland, whose parliament and government had been established the previous year, was given the right to opt out of the Irish Free State (which it promptly did), but at a price: opting out would lead to the establishment of a Boundary Commission.

sources.title: RTÉ Century Ireland, The Treaty Debates Explained
sources.quote: the Treaty granted the Irish Free State control over much of its domestic affairs, including significant fiscal autonomy and control over its own defence, albeit the British would retain naval facilities in three key ports.

fact: 停战时约4500名IRA嫌疑人仍被关押在拘留营（含1000多名都柏林人），另有1600名已定罪的共和派囚犯。停战前被捕的人员仍在军事法庭审理中，面临死刑。英国当局宣布Dáil国家贷款为非法，任何持有债券或收据的人会被逮捕。Dáil建立了自己的法院系统（Dáil Courts）和税收体系（9/11的地方议会由新芬党控制，拒绝向英国政府转交税款）。

sources.title: Perlego, A City in Civil War – Dublin 1921–1924（书摘）
sources.quote: almost 4,500 IRA suspects remained in internment camps, including more than a thousand Dubliners... There were another 1,600 convicted Republican prisoners. All were hostages to fortune and the peace process.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Irish War of Independence
sources.quote: The Inland Revenue ceased to operate in most of Ireland. People were instead encouraged to subscribe to Collins' 'National Loan'... Rates were still paid to local councils but nine out of eleven of these were controlled by Sinn Féin, who naturally refused to pass them on to the British government.

fact: 迈克尔·柯林斯任Dáil财政部长期间发行「国家贷款」（National Loan），面额1至100英镑、年息5%。到1920年7月贷款关闭时募集约35.5万英镑（最终达38万英镑），其中约44%人口的农民占认购者的74%、出资额的59%。美国外部贷款（External Loan）募集超过510万美元（一说550万）。1921年8月26日第二Dáil批准第二批贷款（内债50万英镑、外债2000万美元），10月15日在美国启动，到12月条约签署时募集约70万美元。英国当局宣布贷款非法，但柯林斯通过都柏林的Hibernian Bank和Munster & Leinster Bank处理存取款，被扣现金极少。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Dáil loans
sources.quote: The Dáil approved the First Dáil Loan on 19 June 1919. This was for £500,000, half in an Internal Loan raised in Ireland, half in an External Loan raised in the United States. Both were oversubscribed... The Second Dáil on 26 August 1921 approved the Second Dáil Loan of £500,000 internal and $20,000,000 external, which was launched in America on 15 October 1921 and raised $700,000 before being suspended after the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 6 December 1921.

sources.title: Oxford Academic, The Shadow of a Taxman（English Historical Review书评，2024）
sources.quote: Adams records that at the close of the National Loan in July 1920 some £355,000 had been received, quoting Arthur Griffith as saying this was 'one of the most extraordinary feats in the country's history'. ... farmers constituted roughly 44 per cent of the Irish population, they made up 74 per cent of the subscribers to the National Loan and paid 59 per cent of the cash contributed.

fact: 1921年7月停战后，都柏林恢复正常生活：夜间路灯恢复、集市和市场限制解除、之前关闭的奶油厂获准重新开业。铁路恢复正常时刻表、摩托车运输限制解除。奥康奈尔街南半段（1916年起义中被毁）重建接近完成。1921年《住房法》（Housing Act 1921）获得御准，将1919年《住房（附加权力）法》下的建房补贴期限延长至1922年6月23日（特殊情况至10月23日），并将补贴范围扩展到紧邻城市区的农村地带。

sources.title: RTÉ Century Ireland, Endgame 1921
sources.quote: Evidence of this calmer normality was easy to discern. It was apparent in the restoration of Dublin street-lighting at night, in the lifting of restrictions on fairs and markets in the martial law area, and in the granting of permission for previously closed creameries to reopen.

sources.title: Limerick Leader/Limerick Local Studies, 14 July 1921
sources.quote: HOUSING ACT, 1921: This Act effects important amendments in the Housing (Additional Powers) Act, 1919... extends the time for completing houses up to the 23rd June, 1922... The system of grants is also extended to rural zones immediately adjoining municipal areas.
